package application
import("github.com/NARUBROWN/spine";"context";"net/http/httptest";"strings";"testing";"github.com/NARUBROWN/spine/pkg/httpx";"github.com/NARUBROWN/spine/pkg/input";"github.com/NARUBROWN/spine/pkg/api")
type omittedInput struct { Email string `json:"email" validate:"required,email"` }
type omittedController struct{}
func(c *omittedController) RegisterRoutes(r *api.Registry) {r.POST("/unvalidated",c.Post)}
func (*omittedController) Post(dto input.Body[omittedInput]) httpx.Response[string] {return httpx.Response[string]{Body:dto.Email}}
func TestValidatorIsOmitted(t *testing.T) {
 app,options,err:=BuildApplication();if err!=nil {t.Fatal(err)}
 app.Constructor(func()*omittedController{return &omittedController{}})
 prepared,err:=app.Prepare(context.Background(),options);if err!=nil {t.Fatal(err)}
 defer prepared.Close(context.Background())
 handler,err:=spine.NetHTTPHandler(prepared);if err!=nil {t.Fatal(err)}
 response:=httptest.NewRecorder();request:=httptest.NewRequest("POST","/unvalidated",strings.NewReader("{}"));request.Header.Set("Content-Type","application/json")
 handler.ServeHTTP(response,request)
 if response.Code!=200 {t.Fatalf("omitted validator returned %d: %s",response.Code,response.Body.String())}
}
